scope: Prepared SDR face sample boundaries and both actual pinned host-model wrappers: normalization, NCHW conversion, continuous output mapping, pre-sampled mask compositing, and Natural similarity/margin/offset matrix. No original Android engine execution or whole-style/HDR pipeline claim.

review_fixes_verified.issue: Strict Tanh interval rejected actual FP32 inference at -1.0000001192092896.
review_fixes_verified.resolution: Exactly one outward float32 ULP is allowed and clipped; two ULP excursions are rejected. Verified on both actual wrappers and explicit positive/negative regression cases.

review_fixes_verified.issue: Finite margin1e308 overflowed denominator and returned singular zero-scale crop matrix.
review_fixes_verified.resolution: Nonfinite denominator/nonpositive scale rejected; adversarial margin test passes.

review_fixes_verified.issue: Purity QA included Natural106-point crop metrics without clear separation.

precision_and_layout_findings: Natural literal0.0078 coefficient intentionally retained; its normalized255 endpoint is approximately0.989, not1.
Purity no-extra normalization retains subtract127.5 then float32 reciprocal multiplication order.
Input channels and spatial indexing retained into NCHW; fractional samples remain distinguishable.
Output mapping/composite retain continuous FP64 values after FP32 model and force output alpha1 as both actual fragment shaders do.
Natural min(mask,alpha) and Purity mask*alpha produce distinct verified results.
Known analytical source-to-template transforms establish similarity direction and margin/offset order; crop matrix tolerance1e-12 covers measured FP64 summation roundoff.

publication_scan.scope: Frozen beauty_contract source directory only; __pycache__ excluded.

limitations: Inputs are synthetic, already prepared SDR face samples. No camera colour conversion, source primaries, HDR transform, face detection, selected-face identity or skin-mask generation is verified.

No image warp/resampling implementation is included; callers must supply samples at the correct corresponding shader coordinates. Matrix algebra alone does not reproduce native pose/smash adjustments or texture sampling.
Full makeup/geometry/LUT pass ordering and full Natural blush/Purity2 visual equivalence remain unverified.
Original native inference/byte-rounding/GPU behavior was not executed; tensor/operator parity is a separate model_replay review scope.
Purity legacy decoder and face_point template parsing are dependencies, not newly audited here.
No Android integration, phone performance,10-bit camera-to-save pipeline, HEIF gainmap or HDR preservation claim.
